notes.title: New Free Content! Boss fight and ending level!
notes.notes:
Hi there, friends!

Did you believe [i]Sorgina[/i]’s adventures were over? Well, we still have many stories to tell and places to visit.

One of them is the final confrontation with [b]Gaueko[/b], our heroine’s nemesis, which we couldn’t include in the original launch of the game but we promised to release some time in the future. Since then, we worked on it and we are finally brining it to you for free.

Will you be able to reach the summit of mount Anboto, solve new puzles that will further challenge your abilities and escape from Gaueko’s lurking shadow?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28733850/ad359d20c5fe159e85d29829a7dcaa2de73503f2.jpg[/img]

If you already own the game, [b]download the new update for free[/b].

We really hope you enjoy this new update and like always, we’d love to hear from you in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/627420]Community hub[/url].

Make magic happen!

notes.title: Patch Live! Improved controls and gamepad support!
notes.notes:
Hello!

As promised, the new update is available. We have improved the controls, fixed some bugs and we have added support for gamepad!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28733850/1da39e59e181290680c41a2e5d7aa61572acf2b9.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy the update. Let us know what you think at our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/627420]Community Hub[/url].

[b]Have a great summer! And stay tuned for more news![/b]

notes.title: Improved controls and gamepad support
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

We have listened to your feedback and we´ve been working to improve controls and add gamepad support. We hope you enjoy this new update that will be available in the coming days.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28733850/44221ab06d570ce9791a688a6200b2378cd8afe6.jpg[/img]

We have also made some minor tweaks and are already planning the next big update with new contents and challenges that we hope will surprise you and motivate you to rediscover the game.

As always, we will be really happy if you share your opinions and questions at our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/627420]Community hub[/url]. We´ll be listening :D

Happy Summer Sale! Stay tuned!

notes.title: First Week and Launch Promotion!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28733850/3cca340d065b8c59f6d081aa8f1082c7193e53a8.jpg[/img]

First week of Sorgina on Steam, thanks everyone that has bought the game already. 

We are in the last hours of our launch promotion! It ends on June 6th so take advantage of that [b]15% discount[/b]!

We´ve started thinking about some tweaks and improvements for the coming months and we will talk about them soon.

In the mean time, we will be really happy if you share your opinions and questions us at our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/627420]Community Hub[/url].  

Thanks!

notes.title: Release date set in Stone!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28733850/72626fe618fc6c9d7ebcd54ede8e13aeb6725908.jpg[/img]

[h1]May 30th[/h1] 

On May 30th the game will be available and to celebrate its launch and thank everyone for their support on the [b]Greenlight[/b] campaign, it will be available at a [b]15% discount during its first week[/b] on Steam. 

In the mean time check out the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RMNywUAiUKA]announcement teaser[/url] and we will be really happy if you join us at our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/627420]Community Hub[/url] and share your opinions and questions.

We hope you enjoy the game when released!
